channel_description: My viewers are everyday gym-goers and people trying to lose fat or build muscle who keep hearing scary claims about food, supplements and training online. I take one of those claims per video, such as sugar, sodium, aspartame, energy drinks, alcohol, processed food, cardio timing or how often you need to train, and explain what the research shows and the mechanism behind it. I sound casual and a little sarcastic, like a friend who reads the studies, and I put jargon into plain English. I always give real numbers, turn them into something you can picture, and land on a nuanced answer: it depends, and the dose makes the poison. I always add the caveat that I'm not calling something healthy just because it isn't toxic. I never fearmonger and never call a single ingredient bad on its own. I end on one line that reframes the whole question.
